comment: I had her for Macro and she is one of the best teachers i've had. I found her lectures simple as long as you read the homework chapters and she did a good job of explaining things in simple terms. She will do everything she can to give you a good grade, she even dropped your worst midterm in my class, and is very helpful during office hrs.
don't take her classes. you're not gonna learn anything.

She sucks. Lectures are misleading and never review previous lectures.?Failed to answer most of the questions from students. I can't really remember anything at the end of the semester and I knew I am not alone.

The whole lectures are based on almost blank ppt slides and without those slides there really is nothing to review before exam. It's important to take notes during class but she speak so fast and never really highlight anything. Vague speeches, tough grades on papers, please give me a reason not to regret taking this class. GPA Ruined.

I loved my Econ of the EU class. She was super funny and made the class laugh all the time. I don't think her grading is hard whatsoever. She's super clear in her powerpoint lectures and the midterm is indicative of what she goes over. I did not put much effort in the class but really enjoyed learning about the EU. Good Professor, Would Recommend

Olena is a good professor! Lectures are straightforward and she is easy to follow. Her homework assignments are painfully time consuming though. Be nice to her! You want to be on her good list. I got an A in her class! But it cost me a few late nights.

Good professor but not great. There are better ones in our bschool. Participation is annoying because you feel obligated to participate even though you don?t have anything groundbreaking to say. She is inconsistent with some of the things she says which leads to confusion sometimes. makes you do a presentation. Midterm is same from year to year

I took Olena for Economics of the EU.  She is an alright professor.  Powerpoints EVERYDAY are reallyyyy boring but she does her best.  Tests/paper are alright but not easy.  It was a decent class, but nothing special. It is manageable but not great.
A good teacher.  She certainly cares a lot.  I would take her again and recommend her to other students.  Also the best looking teacher at UR, for what it's worth.

Doesn't do a great job engaging the class.  Class consists of powerpoints and more powerpoints.  Grading is tough, but also arbitrary.  She awards the top 20% of the class A's, next 30% B's, and so on.  She is more helpful in office hours, however. Also easy on the eyes!

This is one of the worst professors I've ever had.  Her classes are all powerpoints, and she treats students like idiots for asking questions. Her grading is completely inconsistent and based on if you phrase something EXACTLY how she wants it, and her midterms are full of things that you have never seen before (I went to class every day, mind you)

Good professor.  She is very clear and up-front. Teaches well and it is easy to follow along. Available outside of class. Only have a few minor quizzes. You definitely need to know your material for the tests and she grades hard, but there is usually an accommodating curve. Overall, very good professor. I would recommend her.
